measures.definition: 1 / (1 + mean Fisher discriminant ratio over encoded features); higher = harder
(∏_j mean pairwise class-range overlap/span)^{1/p}; higher = harder
fraction of points whose nearest neighbour has a different label; higher = harder
mean intra-class NN distance / mean inter-class NN distance; higher = harder
max class count / min class count; higher = more imbalanced
fraction of NA cells in the declared predictor matrix; higher = more missing

note: Primary plots: boxplots of complexity measures by improved = 1{BalAcc(ZS_raw) > BalAcc(M2)}, annotated with univariate logistic regression OR(+1SD) and LRT p-value. Improved uses the dark red from the retired JEV/probe complexity plot.
